statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-69651 (GHSA-3rxq-g8rj-r2cf) is a .NET denial of service issue in XML processing (System.Security.Cryptography.Xml and System.Private.Xml): crafted signed or encrypted XML can cause excessive work. Microsoft lists the .NET 10 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.12 and fixed in 10.0.13 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3rxq-g8rj-r2cf, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/449, https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/135698, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.13/10.0.13.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. Implementation copies of System.Private.Xml.dll are in the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework (dotnet10-runtime, the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap and the runtime archives it carries) and in the runtime and NativeAOT runtime packs, and every one carries the build's own .NET version. Implementation copies of System.Security.Cryptography.Xml.dll are in the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework (aspnetcore10-runtime and dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap), the ASP.NET Core runtime pack and runtime archive, the SDK's own and F# directories, and, in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts, the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml nupkg, the ASP.NET Core and WindowsDesktop transport nupkg files and the Arcade SDK and Build.Tasks.Feed build-tool nupkg files. Each carries the build's own .NET version, except the two build-tool copies (Arcade SDK and Build.Tasks.Feed): in the aarch64 10.0.13-r0 build they are the unfixed 10.0.10 version, and in 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0 they are the fixed 10.0.13 version. So every implementation copy in the first 9 builds (10.0.2-r0 to 10.0.10-r0) is unfixed, 10.0.13-r0 is fixed except for those aarch64 build-tool copies, and 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0 carry the fix in every copy; 10.0.13-r0 therefore reads as affected. The remaining copies are reference assemblies with no implementation code. The range ends at 10.0.14-r0, the first published build in which every implementation copy on both architectures is 10.0.13 or later.

CVE-2026-69651 (GHSA-3rxq-g8rj-r2cf) is a .NET denial of service issue in XML processing (System.Security.Cryptography.Xml and System.Private.Xml): crafted signed or encrypted XML can cause excessive work. The fix adds input-depth and operation-count limits, prohibits DTD processing by default, validates entity references, bounds encrypted-data candidate processing and caps the attributes and namespaces used by C14N transforms. Microsoft lists the .NET 9.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 9.0.0 through 9.0.20 and fixed in 9.0.21: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3rxq-g8rj-r2cf, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/449, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.21/9.0.21.md, and the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml and System.Private.Xml changes in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/compare/v9.0.20...v9.0.21. DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. Implementation copies of System.Private.Xml.dll are in the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework (dotnet9-runtime, and the .NET SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap) and in the runtime and NativeAOT compiler packs, and each carries the build's own .NET version. Implementation copies of System.Security.Cryptography.Xml.dll are in the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework, the ASP.NET Core runtime pack, the SDK's own, F#, dotnet-format and dotnet-watch directories, and, in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts, the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml nupkg, the ASP.NET Core and WindowsDesktop transport nupkg files and the Arcade SDK build-tool nupkg. Each carries the build's own .NET version, except the Arcade SDK copy in the aarch64 9.0.21-r0 build, which is byte-identical to the unfixed 9.0.20 copy (the x86_64 9.0.21-r0 build has a fixed 9.0.21 copy). So the copies in the first 8 builds (9.0.12-r0 to 9.0.20-r0) are unfixed, 9.0.21-r0 is fixed except for that aarch64 build-tool copy, and every implementation copy in 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0 is 9.0.22 or later; the remaining copies are reference assemblies with no implementation code. The range ends at 9.0.22-r0, the first published build in which every implementation copy on both architectures carries the fix, so 9.0.21-r0 reads as affected.
